description: THE TICK. Given the returned seal (64 hex) or the trip id of a customer agent trip, return what Knox sealed when the trip came back: the verdict (LINES_UP or MISMATCH), the finding classes, the door head, when it was sealed, and the Bitcoin status of its hourly batch. Public, no key. The witness is door_observed: the door ran in the agent's own process. The comparison is the agent's report against what the door recorded, not against the outside system's answer.

hash.description: The returned seal: the stamp code of the trip's agent_trip_returned (64 hex chars).

trip_id.description: The trip id the door minted at departure.

name: verify_agent_trip
